Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in Pearland, Texas, when the vehicle turned left and was struck by
Driver 2, who was proceeding straight. Driver 1 was operating the vehicle at the time of the collision and was the only
occupant in the driver's seat, with a Passenger seated beside him. On arrival, officers found both vehicles at rest near
the intersection, with visible front-end damage to Driver 2's vehicle and a corresponding impact to the driver's side of
Driver 1's vehicle, consistent with the reported angle and direction of travel. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness
shortly after the impact, and the nature of the injury appeared consistent with the force of a collision of this kind.
Officers reviewed scene photographs, which confirmed several of the reported details. No independent witnesses
were identified at the scene. Officers found no indication that the vehicle had sustained prior damage in the affected
areas. Driver 1 is reported to reside in the same household as the policyholder and is listed as a covered household
member.
